query:
-- Get the client ID and link it back to the agency
UPDATE agencies a
JOIN clients c ON c.agency_id = a.id
SET a.owner_id = c.id
WHERE a.slug = 'kyle-realty-group';

-- Verify the test account
SELECT a.id AS agency_id, a.name AS agency_name, a.status, c.id AS client_id, c.name AS client_name, c.email, c.subscription_tier, c.subscription_status
FROM agencies a
LEFT JOIN clients c ON c.agency_id = a.id
WHERE a.slug = 'kyle-realty-group';
